text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Matikanetannhauser had finished
all of her training—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'd like to run a bit more today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Fuku-chan-senpai told me
that my lucky item for today
was the 'moon'!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"If I run at night, maybe I'll get an incredible burst of power!
This could be my big chance to transcend my ordinary self!"
choice_data_list: Good luck aiming to step up!
That'll lead to overwork, so no can do.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm going to power up under the moonlight,
so please look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Matikanetannhauser happily
kept running well into the night.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmh... But the power of the moonlight is...
choice_data_list: So just looking at the moon isn't enough, huh?
Is just looking at the moon not enough?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
âAh, you're right.
They didn't actually tell us to run, did they?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'll watch the moon from my room today
and soak up lots of power!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After saying that,
Matikanetannhauser headed back to the dorm.
